note: HELD-OUT TEST SET. Written before any model was run on it, after the system was frozen using the dev set (nlsql_questions.json). Evaluate once; do not tune on it.

questions.question: How many flights have at least one warning-level event?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM event WHERE severity = 1

questions.question: How many arm events were recorded?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'arm'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'arm'

questions.question: How many flights had a vibration_high event?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'vibration_high'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.flight_id) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'vibration_high'

questions.question: How many flights have no critical events?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM semantic.events e WHERE e.flight_id = f.flight_id AND e.severity = 2)
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.flight_id = f.id AND e.severity = 2)

questions.question: How many distinct firmware versions appear in the flights?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT firmware) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT firmware) FROM flight

questions.question: What is the shortest flight duration in seconds, rounded to the nearest second?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(min(duration_s)::numeric) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(min(duration_s)::numeric) FROM flight

questions.question: How many flights were strictly longer than 5 minutes and strictly shorter than 10 minutes?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE duration_s > 300 AND duration_s < 600
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE duration_s > 300 AND duration_s < 600

questions.question: Which firmware version has the most flights?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT firmware FROM semantic.flights GROUP BY firmware ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT firmware FROM flight GROUP BY firmware ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total number of minutes flown across all flights, to the nearest minute?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(sum(duration_s)::numeric / 60) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(sum(duration_s)::numeric / 60) FROM flight

questions.question: How many critical events are there in total?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event WHERE severity = 2

questions.question: What is the second most common event kind?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT kind FROM semantic.events GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT c.key FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id GROUP BY c.key ORDER BY count(*) DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many landing events happened more than 60 seconds into the log?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'landing' AND start_s > 60
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE c.key = 'landing' AND e.ts_start - f.started_at > interval '60 seconds'

questions.question: How many gps_poor events are critical?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'gps_poor' AND severity = 2
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'gps_poor' AND e.severity = 2

questions.question: How many events mention blind land in their description?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE description ILIKE '%blind land%'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event WHERE description ILIKE '%blind land%'

questions.question: Which board had the most takeoff events?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT f.board FROM semantic.events e JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE e.kind = 'takeoff' GROUP BY f.board ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT f.metadata->>'sys_hw' FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE c.key = 'takeoff' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many failsafe_activated events happened on flights longer than 10 minutes?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events e JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE e.kind = 'failsafe_activated' AND f.duration_s > 600
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE c.key = 'failsafe_activated' AND f.duration_s > 600

questions.question: How many flights of the PX4_FMU_V6C board had at least one critical event?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.flight_id) FROM semantic.events e JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE f.board = 'PX4_FMU_V6C' AND e.severity = 2
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.flight_id) FROM event e JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE f.metadata->>'sys_hw' = 'PX4_FMU_V6C' AND e.severity = 2

questions.question: How many flights did the pilot label with external conditions as a cause?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE 'external conditions' = ANY(pilot_error_labels)
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE metadata->'error_labels' @> '[8]'::jsonb

questions.question: How many flights did the pilot rate as crash_pilot?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_rating = 'crash_pilot'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE metadata->>'rating' = 'crash_pilot'

questions.question: How many flights have at least one pilot-selected cause label?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_error_labels IS NOT NULL
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE jsonb_array_length(coalesce(metadata->'error_labels', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0

questions.question: How many flights had the barometric altitude exceed 500 meters at some point?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'baro.altitude' AND max_value > 500
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi, avg(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS mean FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'baro.altitude' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s WHERE hi > 500

questions.question: What is the lowest GPS satellite count recorded in any flight?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT min(min_value) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'gps.satellites'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT min(lo) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi, avg(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS mean FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'gps.satellites' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s

questions.question: How many flights had the roll angle go beyond 90 degrees in either direction at some point?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'attitude.roll' AND (max_value > 90 OR min_value < -90)
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi, avg(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS mean FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'attitude.roll' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s WHERE hi > 90 OR lo < -90

questions.question: What is the average, across flights, of each flight's mean battery voltage? Round to one decimal.
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(avg(mean_value)::numeric, 1) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'battery.voltage'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(avg(mean)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi, avg(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS mean FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'battery.voltage' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s

questions.question: How many signals are in the navigation subsystem?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.signals WHERE subsystem = 'navigation'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM concept s JOIN concept_relation r ON r.src_id = s.id AND r.rel = 'part_of' JOIN concept sub ON sub.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.kind = 'signal' AND sub.key = 'navigation'

questions.question: Which failure modes can the vibration.accel signal indicate?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT related_concept FROM semantic.ontology WHERE concept = 'vibration.accel' AND relation = 'indicates'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT d.key FROM concept_relation r JOIN concept s ON s.id = r.src_id JOIN concept d ON d.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.key = 'vibration.accel' AND r.rel = 'indicates'

questions.question: How many event kinds indicate the motor_failure failure mode?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.ontology WHERE concept_kind = 'event' AND relation = 'indicates' AND related_concept = 'motor_failure'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM concept_relation r JOIN concept s ON s.id = r.src_id JOIN concept d ON d.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.kind = 'event' AND r.rel = 'indicates' AND d.key = 'motor_failure'
